dct_description_sm: The objective of our study was to describe perceptions of transparency among Attending Veterinarians at different universities across Canada. Semi-structured, open-ended interviews were used to describe perceptions and experiences of 16 Attending Veterinarians relating to animal research transparency
dct_title_s: Interviews with 16 Attending Veterinarians at Canadian universities regarding institutional transparency
